```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Repo-relative paths: inputs are read from imports_stable/, outputs are written to analysis_outs/
repo_dir <- (function(d = normalizePath(getwd())) {
  while (!dir.exists(file.path(d, "imports_stable"))) {
    if (dirname(d) == d) stop("Could not find the repo root (folder containing imports_stable/)")
    d <- dirname(d)
  }
  d
})()
imports_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "imports_stable")
outs_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "analysis_outs", "02_combinatorial_screen_signalseq_SIG13")
source(file.path(repo_dir, "functions/r_custom/plotting_fxns.R"))
theme_set(theme_Publication())

plot_dir <- file.path(outs_dir, "plots/qc_barcode_cutoff")
# cutoff scores written by 06_spca_waggr_cutoff_scoring.ipynb
in_dir <- file.path(imports_dir, "SIG13/analysis_outs/qc_barcode_cutoff")
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cutoffs <- 1:10
ref_cutoff <- 7
```

# Goal

Do the sPCA component scores that drive the synergy calls change when the doublet population is called at a different DSB cutoff? `06_spca_waggr_cutoff_scoring.ipynb` scored every cutoff against the same loadings, on the same set of `ligand_call x replicate` pseudobulk units.

# Import

```{r}
scores <- read_csv(file.path(in_dir, "spca_waggr_cutoff_scores_long.csv.gz"), show_col_types = FALSE)
qc <- read_csv(file.path(in_dir, "spca_waggr_cutoff_qc.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

comp_levels <- scores %>%
  distinct(component) %>%
  mutate(idx = as.integer(str_remove(component, "comp_"))) %>%
  arrange(idx) %>%
  pull(component)

scores <- scores %>%
  mutate(component = factor(component, levels = comp_levels),
         cutoff = factor(cutoff, levels = cutoffs))

scores %>% count(cutoff)
```

```{r}
ref_scores <- scores %>%
  filter(cutoff == ref_cutoff) %>%
  select(unit_id, component, ligand_call, score_ref = score)

cat("pseudobulk units:", n_distinct(ref_scores$unit_id),
    " components:", n_distinct(ref_scores$component), "\n")
```

# Concordance with DSB7

```{r}
vs_ref <- scores %>%
  filter(cutoff != ref_cutoff) %>%
  left_join(ref_scores %>% select(unit_id, component, score_ref), by = c("unit_id", "component"))

vs_ref %>%
  group_by(cutoff) %>%
  summarise(pearson = cor(score, score_ref),
            spearman = cor(score, score_ref, method = "spearman"),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
p_conc <- vs_ref %>%
  group_by(cutoff, unit_id) %>%
  summarise(pearson = cor(score, score_ref),
            spearman = cor(score, score_ref, method = "spearman"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(pearson, spearman), names_to = "metric", values_to = "r") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cutoff, y = r, colour = cutoff)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  facet_wrap(~metric) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo", end = 0.9) +
  labs(x = "DSB cutoff", y = "correlation with DSB7 scores",
       title = "Component scores vs. DSB7 (each point = one pseudobulk unit)")

p_conc
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "spca_score_concordance_cutoffs.pdf"), p_conc, width = 10, height = 5)
```

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=3}
p_scatter <- vs_ref %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = score_ref, y = score)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~cutoff, nrow = 1) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  labs(x = "DSB7 score", y = "cutoff score")

p_scatter
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "spca_score_scatter_cutoffs.pdf"), p_scatter, width = 12, height = 3)
```

# Pairwise cutoff concordance

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
wide <- scores %>%
  select(unit_id, component, cutoff, score) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cutoff, values_from = score) %>%
  select(all_of(as.character(cutoffs)))

pair_mat <- cor(wide, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

p_heat <- as_tibble(pair_mat, rownames = "cutoff_a") %>%
  pivot_longer(-cutoff_a, names_to = "cutoff_b", values_to = "r") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cutoff_a, y = cutoff_b, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r)), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  labs(x = "DSB cutoff", y = "DSB cutoff",
       title = "Component-score correlation between cutoffs")

p_heat
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "spca_score_pairwise_heatmap.pdf"), p_heat, width = 6, height = 5)
```
